## Conservative Leaders and Veterans
### Brevard Sheriff Wayne Ivey
“Endorsing Dan Green for Congress is an easy choice. I know he will stand with President Trump to keep our communities safe, protect our military, and grow our economy even stronger. Dan Green has fought for our nation overseas and he stands ready to take that fight to continue protecting America to Washington, D.C.!”
### Osceola Sheriff Chris Blackmon
“Dan understands the challenges our law enforcement officers face each day, and I know he will fight tirelessly to secure our borders, support law enforcement, and uphold the rule of law. I am proud to endorse America First candidate, Dan Green for United States Congress, District 9.”
### Senator Danny Burgess, SD 23
“I am honored to endorse my friend Dan Green for Congress. Floridians deserve a fighter in Washington who will stand with President Trump and put our families first. As a fellow service member, I deeply value Dan’s military experience and lifelong commitment to serving our nation. He is a proven leader and uniquely qualified to legislate with wisdom, discipline, and integrity. I know Dan will be ready on day one to take on the Swamp and fight for Florida families.”
### Representative Patt Maney, HD 4
“Dan Green is the constitutional conservative Florida needs in Congress. He’s an America First patriot who will represent District 9 extremely well. He has my complete endorsement!”
### Mayor of Indian River Shores Brian Foley
“Dan Green is the only candidate with the energy, intellect, and courage to tackle the issues necessary to restore American greatness. A native son of Indian River County, Dan served his country faithfully during multiple tours in Afghanistan and Iraq. Dan is not just the best choice, but the only choice for Florida District 9.”
### Carole Jean Jordan, Tax Collector for Indian River County and Former Chair of the Republican Party of Florida
“Dan is the most formidable candidate in this race. His service to America is exceptional. He brings people together, gets results, and means what he says. District 9 has a defender who wants to fix increasing costs and the pressures we are facing. Dan will put Florida and America first.”
### Former Indian River County Republican State Committeeman Joe Coakley
“Dan is the right man for these times to represent all residents of District 9. He’s the only one in the race who has the tenacity, intelligence, and drive to solve our affordability and cost of living issues.”
### Former Representative for Indian River and Brevard Counties Ralph Poppell
“Guided by an unwavering commitment to the U. S. Constitution, Dan stands firmly in putting America first. Dan has the wisdom to listen, the humility to learn, and the courage to lead – qualities that ensure decisions are made with both conviction and care. America needs leaders like Dan who put our country first always.”
### Former Indian River County Tax Collector and Former Representative Charlie Sembler
“The 9th District, Florida, and America need Dan Green. Never before have we had a candidate like this. He knows how to really put America first and be America First.”
### President and CEO of Riverfront Packing Company Dan Richey
“Dan Green is a statesman, not a politician. It’s rare that we get a man of his caliber as a candidate for Congress. He is well prepared to represent us and will hit the ground running on day one.”
### Former Secretary of Commerce for Florida Jamal Sowell
“Dan Green is a war veteran and true patriot. He exemplifies an exceptional and longstanding commitment to fighting for America. With deep Florida roots and a career dedicated to prioritizing veterans and the military, he embodies the leadership we need to ensure that the best interests of Floridians are represented in Congress.”
### Founder of the Puerto Rican Chamber of Commerce Dr. Justin Valez-Hagan
“No candidate combines strategic thinking and public service as effectively as Dan Green. His commitment to engaging the Puerto Rican community and understanding the issues that matter most to our families demonstrate his thoughtful leadership that all Floridians deserve.”
### Chairman of Goldstar Fathers of Florida Kris Hager
“Dan’s service to country, his deep care for our veterans and their families, and his red-blooded patriotism are what District 9 needs. Florida’s Gold Star families know they have a friend and faithful advocate in Dan Green.”
### U.S. Navy SEAL (ret.), recipient of the Navy Cross, Silver Star, Bronze Star with “V” and Purple Heart LT Mark Donald
“Having served with Dan, I know he is a man of honesty, understanding, and intelligence. His steadfast commitment to our nation and problem-solving skills mean we have a man focused on fixing the issues, not just another politician. After years of friendship and personal wartime service with Dan, I proudly voice my support for Dan Green for Congress.”
### Retired U.S. Army and CIA operative that led the operation that killed Che Guevara – Félix Rodríguez
“Dan Green is the fighter we need in Congress. He has faithfully served our country as a Naval Officer for 23 years and deployed five times to Iraq and Afghanistan. He is the only America First candidate who will stand up to Communism and the radical left.”
### Senator Connie Mack III, Former U.S. Senator for Florida
“Dan Green is the true conservative fighter we need in Congress. Dan is all about service to country and getting the job done. He is the leader and team player Florida and America needs.”
### Congressman Jim Jordan, House Judiciary Committee Chairman
“Dan Green honorably served America both here and around the world, and his dedication to our nation is without question. As a Trump appointee, Dan was a steady hand and trusted voice on some of our nation’s most pressing issues. Dan Green is the conservative leader we can count on to stand up to the radicals in Washington. Now, more than ever, our country needs leaders like Dan Green in Congress.”
### Congressman Mike Haridopolos
“President Trump and I need proven conservatives willing to fight with us for the American people. Dan Green has defended our nation, lives our values and has proven he can defeat radicals. I am honored to endorse Dan Green for Congress because I know he will put America first and continue his fight to defend the freedoms our fellow Floridians hold dear.”
### Representative Dana Trabulsy
Florida House District 84
